meta.description: The ORVIBO Bauhaus series of smart ambient lights, made for modern, upscale homes: a dining pendant, a floor lamp and a wall lamp with Zigbee smart control, gesture sensing and wireless switching, part of a complete smart lighting solution.

Glowing up and down,
a melody over the dining table

Below, a focused light falls only on the table,

Crisp, clean-edged pools of light
